''See also: [[Lesser Treasure Hall Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The Lesser Treasure [[Hall]], also known as the Lesser Treasure [[Hall]] of Heaven's Glory{{!}}Heaven’s Glory, is the smallest of three distinct treasure halls maintained by the [[Heaven’s Glory School]]. Despite its status as the least significant of the three, it contains priceless artifacts—including weapons, [[elixirs]], [[constructs]], and training supplements—that are valuable enough to be used as ransom by major clans. The hall is a large, open room featuring rows of display cases or pedestals protected by transparent panes of [[Forged madra]]. A prominent golden sign with [[aura]]-gathering Script{{!}}script identifies the building, making it visible even at night. The facility is overseen by [[Elder Rahm]] and is protected by a [[Jade]] [[Forger]], Script{{!}}script-activated Security constructs{{!}}security constructs hidden within the floors, and locked doors. While high-achieving disciples who complete the [[Trial of Glorious Ascension]] before sunset are permitted to select a single item for personal use, some items, such as [[halfsilver]] weapons, are kept on open shelves rather than in cases.}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|The Lesser Treasure [[Hall]] is one of three treasure halls located within the Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School. Identified by a towering sign featuring its name in gold letters, the facility houses various weapons, training supplements, [[elixirs]], and [[constructs]]. Disciples are permitted to select treasures from this hall once they have successfully survived the [[Trial of Glorious Ascension]]. While a [[Jade]] [[Forger]] resides above the hall, the area is heavily protected by deadly [[constructs]] and [[security scripts]] hidden within its floors and locked doors.}}
